hook: In 1586, Margaret Clitherow, a pregnant woman in York, England, was crushed to death for her Catholic faith.

sections.voiceover: In 1586, Margaret Clitherow, a pregnant woman in York, England, was crushed to death for her Catholic faith.
sections.visual_cue: Historical illustration of 16th-century York with dramatic shadows and tense atmosphere.
sections.sfx_cue: Heavy wooden thud followed by low ambient drone

sections.voiceover: England had outlawed Catholicism, so priests hid in secret rooms called priest holes — and Margaret was accused of hiding one.
sections.visual_cue: Close-up of a handwritten 1586 trial record document transition to a map of York.

sections.voiceover: She refused to enter a legal plea while pregnant with her fourth child.
sections.visual_cue: Close-up of a historical document with wax seal, dramatic lighting.

sections.voiceover: Because she would not plead, they crushed her to death under heavy weights on Lady Day in March 1586.
sections.visual_cue: Cinematic pan across a crowd of onlookers in historic attire gathered in a cobblestone square.
sections.sfx_cue: Subtle crowd murmur and wind swell

sections.voiceover: Nearly twenty years later, Guy Fawkes became infamous in York as part of the Gunpowder Plot to blow up Parliament.
sections.visual_cue: Historical portrait of Guy Fawkes alongside gunpowder plot documents.

sections.voiceover: Historians theorise that Fawkes may have witnessed Margaret Clitherow's execution nineteen years earlier.
sections.visual_cue: Split image: Margaret Clitherow's execution on one side, Guy Fawkes on the other.

sections.voiceover: Christopher and John Wright also knew her story.
sections.visual_cue: Portraits of Christopher Wright and John Wright alongside historical documents.

sections.voiceover: Her brutal death may have shaped their thinking before the 1605 plot.
sections.visual_cue: Gunpowder Plot conspirators document with dramatic shadows.

sections.voiceover: Two events, nineteen years apart, both in York, both shaped by religious conflict.
sections.visual_cue: Slow zoom out on the historic city walls of York under a dusk sky.
sections.sfx_cue: Deep ringing bell chime fading out
